_comment: Draft template. One entry per specification id in the analysis plan. Use null for values that are genuinely unknown; never substitute a plausible guess. Delete the fields that do not apply and record why in `justification`.

entries.estimand_note: what is random and across which repetitions the standard error describes variation
entries.method: robust | cluster | twoway_cluster | multiway_cluster | wild_cluster_bootstrap | hac | driscoll_kraay | conley | randomization_inference | other
entries.assignment_level: level at which treatment is assigned
entries.small_sample_correction: package default | explicit setting name | unknown
entries.degrees_of_freedom_rule: how df is computed, including absorbed fixed effects and dropped singletons
entries.justification: one or two sentences tying the choice to the design
entries.decision_order_note: when this choice was made relative to seeing the results
